output.reason: The evidence does not state whether the in-force directions do or do not specify a maximum (cap) interest rate for loans to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSE). It only indicates (i) interest on unpaid interest should be at the contracted rate (not penal) until remediation, (ii) directions about levy of pre-payment charges for certain floating rate loans, and (iii) a requirement to prominently display the minimum, maximum and average interest rates charged on microfinance loans. This does not establish that the directions lack a maximum interest-rate cap for MSE loans.
